errors.text: The proposed Si addition does not reconstruct the demonstrated 4.2 at.% Cr intervention, and the cited evidence does not establish that minor Si additions to Hf-Mo-Ta-Ti-Zr form a reticulated C15 Laves phase.

The predicted density increase is chemically and directionally questionable: adding low-density Si should not inherently increase the alloy density, whereas the intended intervention addresses the high-density limitation.

The falsification experiment does not cleanly distinguish solid-solution hardening from the phase-topology mechanism because it lacks a matched single-phase control and quantitative lattice-parameter or solute-strain measurements.
The claimed Hf-Mo-Si C15 Laves chemistry, crack bridging mechanism, and spinodal-decomposition route are speculative and are not supported by the supplied evidence.
